summary: A man whose sister cut contact after he voted differently still sends her a Christmas gift every year.
realLife: A Midwestern man who backed a candidate in 2016 said his sister in Seattle stopped contact after that vote. They have not spoken since. He still sends her a gift each Christmas and has never had a reply.
gates: A break in contact is recorded after a vote.
One sibling still acts on the tie.
inGame: Quarrel record and ties can hold a one-way gift; needs: a gift or card event that the other side can leave unanswered.

turns.what: The sender stops sending after a few years.
A reply finally comes after a death in the family.
The gift is accepted but unacknowledged in words.
